name: Vertical slider
description: Lift a rigid carriage by 30 mm using a 0.4 N motor under gravity; preserve the guide/stop and reduce mass. No stress/fatigue claim.
reasoning: Scripted external agent / deterministic managed fixture

assumptions.description: Homogeneous rigid aluminium; ideal guide; normal soft contact; no stresses or fatigue
assumptions.applicability: This two-body nominal rigid slider only

tests.applicability: Validated two-solid vertical guide, normal contact only

mechanism.approximation: Ideal z guide and gravity-compensated force motor. AABB collision fills internal pockets; full rectangular bottom is independently checked. Soft frictionless contact is numerical, not calibrated material compliance.

load_cases.description: Gravity-compensated PD ramp/hold then independent zero-actuation drop-to-stop scenario
load_cases.boundary_conditions: Fixed base, ideal world-z guide; two separate trajectories reset to CAD pose and zero velocity

mass_g.method: Independent motion/equilibrium references and both timestep refinements; nominal uncalibrated allowance

tracking_error_m.method: Independent motion/equilibrium references and both timestep refinements; nominal uncalibrated allowance

settled_penetration_m.method: Independent motion/equilibrium references and both timestep refinements; nominal uncalibrated allowance

equilibrium_error_n.method: Independent motion/equilibrium references and both timestep refinements; nominal uncalibrated allowance

peak_actuation_n.method: Independent motion/equilibrium references and both timestep refinements; nominal uncalibrated allowance

tests.mesh_rule: Exact BRep volume inertia in SI; AABB contact restricted to full bottom-plane motion; no triangle-mesh contact approximation

simulation.geometry_assumptions: Two solids with full horizontal contact planes and contained vertical path

estimate.basis: Two scenarios, three timestep levels: 112000 steps plus CAD import and references
estimate.uncertainty: Conservative initial CPU throughput estimate; actual timing/steps/RSS archived, no adequacy guarantee
